payload.name: Upload Limit Fixer by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup upload error matcher for PDF, image, photo, and file-size limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based upload limit fixer that maps common rejected upload messages to the right no-upload PDF/image tool. It helps with PDF under 1MB or 500KB, image under KB/MB targets, wrong file type, PDF-to-JPG, photo dimensions, screenshots, resume PDFs, and email attachment limits. It requires no account, no file upload to a server, no private document, ID photo, portal login, payment, tax, or account data. Optional USD 9 manual fix-plan requests are separate and only after a public-safe fit check.
